version: Configuration only; retained per-task parents; 2 matched one-factor candidates

ted.loss: alpha5 weighted two-logit BCE, summed gradients; step on final partial batch

tlp.loss: adaptive positive-weight BCE on upper-triangular unobserved pairs only; no self-loops, no observed edges; no candidate filtering

model_families.tlp: stage4 deterministic region reduction; voxel descriptor unchanged

selection: All shared-config deltas and equal-search best-per-arm validation scores; no test use and no maximization of full-ablation gap

configs.slow_decay: initial LR unchanged; TED inverse decay divisor3; TLP step40 gamma0.1
